name: com.gurgaonbakers/catalogue
title: Gurgaon Bakers Catalogue
description: Gurgaon Bakers cakes, Gurgaon (India): live catalogue, delivery checks, exact quotes, checkout links

tools.name: search_cakes
tools.description:
Search Gurgaon Bakers' live cake catalogue. Use for any request to find, compare or price cakes.
    query: free text, e.g. "1 kg eggless chocolate truffle birthday" - weight, egg/eggless and budget words in the
    text are understood. Optional filters: category slug (e.g. "cakes-for-kids"), eggless (true = eggless,
    false = with egg), max_price (INR, incl. GST), weight (e.g. "1 Kg", "500 g").
    Returns at most 10 cakes (no pagination). Each result has match.variant = the exact price and order link for the
    requested weight/egg option. Constraints are never relaxed silently: status "no_match" comes with clearly
    labelled alternatives that do NOT meet the request. Read-only; places no order.

tools.name: get_cake
tools.description:
Full details of one cake by slug (from search_cakes): description, weights, egg/eggless options and the exact
    price (INR incl. GST) of every variant, each with an order_url. Use before quoting a price for a specific
    weight/option. Read-only.

tools.name: get_delivery_info
tools.description:
Delivery and ordering rules: same-day cutoffs, delivery hours, checkout time slots, fees (delivery fee by
    locality, small-order handling fee, 5% GST on fees), contact numbers and cancellation/complaint policy.
    Pass a locality (e.g. "Sector 56", "DLF Phase 2") to get only its delivery fee. For a yes/no on a specific
    date and time use check_delivery instead. Read-only.

tools.name: build_order_link
tools.description:
Order link for the customer: opens the cake page on gurgaonbakers.com with the chosen weight (e.g. "1 Kg") and
    egg option ("Eggless" default, or "Egg") pre-selected, plus the exact price. The customer adds flavour and
    message, picks the delivery date/slot and pays on the website. Does NOT place, hold or confirm an order.

tools.name: get_business_info
tools.description:
Who Gurgaon Bakers is: verified contact (phone/WhatsApp/email), ordering channels and hours, delivery hours,
    eggless policy, cancellation/complaint policy, coverage summary and what this server can and cannot do.
    Use for "who are you / how do I contact / do you deliver in Gurgaon" questions. Read-only.

tools.name: check_delivery
tools.description:
Can a cake be delivered to a Gurgaon locality on a date and time? date: YYYY-MM-DD, "today" or "tomorrow"
    (default today); time optional, e.g. "15:30" or "3 pm" (India time). Returns status (available_online,
    phone_only, special_request, check_by_phone, not_a_standard_slot, not_available), that day's slots with the
    latest time to order online, the locality's delivery fee and a message to show the customer. This applies the
    published rules; it does not reserve a slot. Read-only.

tools.name: start_custom_cake_enquiry
tools.description:
For a custom design not in the catalogue (e.g. the customer shares a reference photo or a detailed idea).
    First offer similar cakes with search_cakes. If the customer still wants a custom cake, collect what they know
    (design, occasion, weight or number of people, flavour, egg/eggless, date, time, locality, message, budget) and call
    this. It returns a WhatsApp link to Gurgaon Bakers with the details pre-written; the customer attaches their
    reference photo there and the team replies with the price. Do not quote or estimate a price for custom designs.

tools.name: get_order_quote
tools.description:
Exact price breakdown for up to 5 items before checkout: each item's variant price (INR incl. GST), the
    small-order handling fee (₹75 + GST under ₹2,000), bulk discount (₹150 off from ₹4,000 with 2+ cakes) and the
    delivery fee for the locality. Without a locality the total is marked incomplete. Does not reserve anything;
    checkout shows the final amount before payment.

tools.name: create_checkout_link
tools.description:
Use when the customer has chosen and wants to buy. Returns checkout_url: opening it puts the chosen items
    (weight, egg option, quantity, flavour, message) into the customer's own cart on gurgaonbakers.com with the
    locality pre-selected; the customer then picks date/slot, enters details and pays on the website. Also returns
    the quote. Photo cakes return cake-page links instead (photo upload needed). Creates no order and stores
    nothing; ask the customer to confirm the items first.
